profile.headline: Software Developer at Sentry Insurance
profile.summary: Software Developer with the ability to adapt and perform detailed tasks in high stress environments. Customer service focused background allowing for excellent communication skills.

positions.title: Computer Lab Assistant
positions.description:
•	Constructed answer keys for programming courses
•	Maintained class room presence, visible, and available to students requiring technical assistance
•	Tutored students enrolled to understand the concepts presented by the instructor
•	Maintained computer equipment

positions.title: Sales Floor Associate
positions.description:
•	Provided constant presence on sales floor to ensure customers’ needs are fulfilled
•	Recommend appropriate items by initiating conversation with customers
•	Unloaded trucks, stocked shelves and carried merchandise out onto the sales floor 
•	Responded to customer phone calls with the use of exceptional communication skills

positions.title: Housewares Lead
positions.description:
•	Unpacked new merchandise shipments, and prepared them for the selling floor by consolidating and making room for new product
•	Constructed product display models throughout multiple departments
•	Trained new employees
•	Responded to customer phone calls to the department 
•	Replied to Customer Service back-up requests

positions.title: Sales Floor Associate
positions.description:
•	Ensured customer service standards are upheld when on the sales floors
•	Sales floor recovery 
•	Answered department phone calls
•	Cash register back-up response

positions.title: Cashier
positions.description:
•	Till counting
•	Assisted customers
•	Shelf facing and recovery
